test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that contains a grammatical error in the underlined portion.**

I love Kolkata. It is a beautiful city located in the Bay of Bengal, symbolising the unification of assimilation of culture and integrity.

options.text: I love Kolkata. It is a beautiful city located in the Bay of Bengal, symbolising __the unification__ of assimilation of culture and integrity
I love Kolkata. __It is a beautiful city located in the Bay of Bengal__, symbolising the unification of assimilation of culture and integrity.
__I love Kolkata__. It is a beautiful city located in the Bay of Bengal, symbolising the unification of assimilation of culture and integrity.
I love Kolkata. It is a beautiful city located in the Bay of Bengal, symbolising the unification __of assimilation of culture and integrity__

solution:
The correct answer is: "I love Kolkata. It is a beautiful city located in the Bay of Bengal, symbolising the unification __of assimilation of culture and integrity__**.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**unification of assimilation**" is redundant and grammatically incorrect.
 
• The issue here is redundancy and a lack of clarity in the use of the words "**unification**" and "**assimilation**" together.
 
• Both words have similar meanings related to the blending or integration of cultures or ideas, and using them together in this context is repetitive and unclear.
 
• The correct phrase would be "**assimilation of cultures**" or "**unification of cultures.**"
 
• The sentence could also be rephrased as "It is a beautiful city located in the Bay of Bengal, symbolizing the assimilation and unification of different cultures with integrity."

Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer.
